description: Ten actual web searches were captured. French searches addressed all four February date windows; English searches covered the month and selected windows, but 1–14 February was combined in one query and dates 8–14 were not separately targeted in English. Local/regional searches included Cameroon News Agency and Journal du Cameroun terms, and search-result leads for Yaounde, Douala, Bamenda, Buea, Ebolowa, Bafoussam and Ngaoundere. Open web only; no LexisNexis or systematically searchable local newspaper archive.
required_followup: If further bounded coverage is assigned, run distinct English searches for 1–7 and 8–14 February and targeted local-language/regional outlet queries. Do not infer no protests from current searches.

description: The body-read Togonyigba report confirms the CAWOF strike began 13 February over the government-set SMIG, but describes low participation at work sites and no street/public assembly or count. A separate assembly remains unresolved.
required_followup: Seek a distinct dated contemporary report or organizer/public record specifically describing an executed public gathering and simultaneous turnout; do not code the strike alone.

description: The OTS/OTA/SECA teachers source is a rendered search result from a Scribd-hosted user upload announcing a 6–10 February strike. Execution, the original communiqué, and any public assembly/attendance are unverified.
required_followup: If material, find an independent contemporaneous report or official/union public record of execution and any actual public gathering. Do not treat the uploaded announcement as occurrence evidence.

description: A VOA report opened during February research is dated 8 March and describes a cost-of-living protest on that date in Yaounde and other towns. It is outside February and is retained for March onset ownership; no evidence says it began in February.
required_followup: Use the already captured body in the March unit without reopening it; search for independent contemporaneous March 8 reporting and check whether any distinct February episode existed.

description: Cameroon News Agency search result titled Mothers from Ekona on a peaceful protest in Buea has no visible date, turnout, exact demand or state target in the indexed result.
required_followup: Search the exact title/URL in the assigned March follow-up only if unique and not repeated; establish event date, turnout and demand before coding.
